qe: What surprising biochemical fact characterises the fundamental composition of a biological living system?
qh: एक जैविक जीवित प्रणाली (living system) की मौलिक संरचना की क्या आश्चर्यजनक जैव रासायनिक विशेषता है?
o: It is constructed exclusively from highly volatile liquid gases
It is beautifully composed of entirely non-living atoms and molecules
It completely lacks chemical elements belonging to the p-block
It is structurally stabilized by toxic inorganic arsenic chains
e: Explanation: A fascinating paradox of structural biology is that highly complex, responsive living systems are entirely built from combinations of ordinary, non-living chemical atoms and molecules.

qe: Which specialized group of macromolecular compounds are universally recognized as the primary producers of carbohydrates in global ecosystems?
qh: वैश्विक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में कार्बोहाइड्रेट के प्राथमिक उत्पादक के रूप में मैक्रोमोलेक्यूलर यौगिकों के किस विशेष समूह को सार्वभौमिक रूप से मान्यता प्राप्त है?
o: Terrestrial and aquatic plants (पादप / पौधे)
Systemic mammalian liver tissues
Gram-negative bacterial cultures
Non-living atmospheric carbon segments
e: Explanation: Carbohydrates are primary organic materials synthesized predominantly by plants through photosynthesis, creating an extensive reservoir of energy for heterotrophic organisms.

qe: What was the initial empirical chemical definition assigned to carbohydrates in historical chemistry, based on the general mathematical formula $C_x(H_2O)_y$?
qh: सामान्य गणितीय सूत्र $C_x(H_2O)_y$ के आधार पर, ऐतिहासिक रसायन विज्ञान में कार्बोहाइड्रेट को क्या प्रारंभिक मूलानुपाती रासायनिक परिभाषा दी गई थी?
o: Oxidized open-chain dibasic amino acids
Hydrates of carbon (कार्बन के हाइड्रेट)
Chlorinated derivatives of biological lipids
Quaternary ammonium halide structures
e: Explanation: Historically, because the elemental composition of many common sugars fit the general ratio $C_x(H_2O)_y$, carbohydrates were literally defined and named as 'hydrates of carbon'.

qe: Why was the historical definition defining carbohydrates simply as 'hydrates of carbon' chemically abandoned by modern biochemists?
qh: कार्बोहाइड्रेट को केवल 'कार्बन के हाइड्रेट' के रूप में परिभाषित करने वाली ऐतिहासिक परिभाषा को आधुनिक जैव रसायनविदों द्वारा रासायनिक रूप से क्यों छोड़ दिया गया?
o: Because carbohydrates were found to lack carbon atoms entirely inside their structures
Because non-carbohydrate compounds like acetic acid ($CH_3COOH$) fit the formula ratio, while genuine sugars like rhamnose do not
Because it required the absolute exclusion of all oxygen groups from the sugar matrix
Because it failed to explain the common-ion precipitation effect of sodium chloride
e: Explanation: The old formula $C_x(H_2O)_y$ is inaccurate. Acetic acid ($C_2(H_2O)_2$) fits the ratio but exhibits no sugar properties, whereas rhamnose ($C_6H_{12}O_5$) is a carbohydrate but does not fit the mathematical formula.

qe: What is the precise modern structural and chemical definition assigned to the macro-class of materials known as carbohydrates?
qh: कार्बोहाइड्रेट के रूप में जाने जाने वाले सामग्रियों के व्यापक वर्ग को दी गई सटीक आधुनिक संरचनात्मक और रासायनिक परिभाषा क्या है?
o: Optically inactive linear aromatic hydrocarbons with single bonds
Optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes or ketones, or compounds yielding them upon hydrolysis (पॉलीहाइड्रॉक्सी एल्डिहाइड या कीटोन)
Unbranched non-ionic long-chain potassium fatty acid salts
Suicidal competitive enzyme inhibitors with irreversible networks
e: Explanation: Modern chemistry defines carbohydrates based on their structural features: they are optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes or polyhydroxy ketones, or complex structures that break down into these subunits upon chemical hydrolysis.

qe: Which carbohydrate represents the primary disaccharide sugar natively present within mammalian milk fluids?
qh: कौन सा कार्बोहाइड्रेट स्तनधारी दूध के तरल पदार्थों (milk fluids) के भीतर प्राकृतिक रूप से मौजूद प्राथमिक डिसेकेराइड चीनी का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: Sucrose
Lactose (लैक्टोज)
Maltose
Starch
e: Explanation: Lactose is a disaccharide systematically referred to as milk sugar because it is the primary carbohydrate component found naturally within mammalian milk.

qe: What happens to a carbohydrate classified as a monosaccharide when subjected to standard chemical hydrolysis conditions?
qh: मानक रासायनिक जलअपघटन (hydrolysis) स्थितियों के अधीन होने पर मोनोसेकेराइड के रूप में वर्गीकृत कार्बोहाइड्रेट का क्या होता है?
o: It breaks down cleanly into two different polyhydroxy ketones
It cannot be further hydrolyzed into simpler carbohydrate subunits (आगे जलअपघटन नहीं होता)
It converts immediately into an unbranched biodegradable laundry surfactant
It establishes strong covalent cross-links with the allosteric sites of enzymes
e: Explanation: Monosaccharides are the basic structural units of carbohydrates. Because they are already single polyhydroxy units, they cannot be broken down further into simpler sugars via hydrolytic cleavage.

qe: A carbohydrate that yields anywhere from two to ten monosaccharide subunits upon complete chemical hydrolysis belongs to which structural category?
qh: एक कार्बोहाइड्रेट जो पूर्ण रासायनिक जलअपघटन पर दो से दस मोनोसेकेराइड उपइकाइयाँ देता है, किस संरचनात्मक श्रेणी के अंतर्गत आता है?
o: Monosaccharide
Oligosaccharide (ओलिगोसैकेराइड)
Polysaccharide
Polyamide fiber
e: Explanation: Oligosaccharides are a class of carbohydrates defined by their capacity to yield a small number of monosaccharide units, typically between 2 and 10, when treated with water and an acid catalyst.

qe: Which pair of monosaccharide subunits are released when a molecule of table sugar (sucrose) undergoes acidic hydrolysis?
qh: जब टेबल शुगर (सुक्रोज) का एक अणु अम्लीय जलअपघटन से गुजरता है तो मोनोसेकेराइड उपइकाइयों की कौन सी जोड़ी निकलती है?
o: Two identical units of D-galactose
One molecule of D-glucose and one molecule of D-fructose (ग्लूकोज एवं फ्रुक्टोज)
Two units of highly branched amylopectin
One molecule of glycine and one molecule of aminocaproic acid
e: Explanation: Hydrolyzing the disaccharide sucrose breaks its internal glycosidic linkage, releasing an equimolar mixture of one D-glucose molecule and one D-fructose molecule.

qe: Why are polysaccharides like starch and cellulose formally classified as non-sugars in structural biochemistry?
qh: संरचनात्मक जैव रसायन में स्टार्च और सेलुलोज जैसे पॉलीसेकेराइड को औपचारिक रूप से गैर-शर्करा (non-sugars) के रूप में क्यों वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
o: Because they contain a high concentration of basic amine functional groups
Because they are not sweet in taste (स्वाद में मीठे नहीं होते)
Because they dissolve instantly in cold alcohol to generate volatile esters
Because they contain permanent disulfide bridges across their linear layers
e: Explanation: Unlike simple mono- and disaccharides, high-molecular-weight polysaccharides are large, relatively insoluble macromolecules that lack a sweet taste, classifying them as non-sugars.

qe: What specific chemical test defines whether a carbohydrate sugar is classified as a reducing sugar or a non-reducing sugar?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट रासायनिक परीक्षण यह परिभाषित करता है कि कार्बोहाइड्रेट शर्करा को अपचायी शर्करा (reducing sugar) या अनअपचायी शर्करा के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Its ability to undergo rapid nitration with fuming nitric acid
Its capacity to reduce Fehling's solution and Tollen's reagent (फेलिंग एवं टोलेंस अभिकर्मक का अपचयन)
Its solubility profile in volatile ether-based non-polar fluids
Its behavior under high-pressure ring-opening polymerization runs
e: Explanation: Reducing sugars contain a free, reactive anomeric hemiacetal or hemiketal center that can reduce mild oxidizing solutions like Fehling's or Tollen's reagents. If these groups are locked in a glycosidic bond, the sugar is non-reducing.

qe: According to structural guidelines, what can be stated about the reducing capacity of all common monosaccharides, whether they contain an aldose or ketose functional center?
qh: संरचनात्मक दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार, सभी सामान्य मोनोसेकेराइड्स की अपचायक क्षमता (reducing capacity) के बारे में क्या कहा जा सकता है, चाहे उनमें एल्डोज या कीटोज कार्यात्मक केंद्र हो?
o: They are entirely non-reducing under all biochemical conditions
All monosaccharides are reducing sugars (सभी मोनोसैकेराइड अपचायी शर्करा होते हैं)
Only aldoses are reducing, while ketoses behave as inert thermosetting resins
They undergo complete conversion into insoluble calcium precipitates
e: Explanation: A key rule in carbohydrate chemistry is that all monosaccharides—including aldoses and ketoses (like fructose, which isomerizes to an aldose via an enediol intermediate under basic conditions)—act as reducing sugars.

qe: What structural term describes a carbohydrate containing six carbon atoms and an aldehyde functional group inside its open chain?
qh: कौन सा संरचनात्मक शब्द छह कार्बन परमाणुओं और अपनी खुली श्रृंखला के भीतर एक एल्डिहाइड कार्यात्मक समूह वाले कार्बोहाइड्रेट का वर्णन करता है?
o: Aldopentose
Aldohexose (एल्डोहेक्सोज)
Ketohexose
Ketotriose
e: Explanation: D-glucose features six carbon atoms and a terminal aldehyde functional group, classifying it as an aldohexose. Fructose, which has a ketone group instead, is classified as a ketohexose.

qe: Which physical raw materials are condensed on a large commercial scale to manufacture high-purity industrial glucose via hydrolysis?
qh: हाइड्रोलिसिस के माध्यम से उच्च शुद्धता वाले औद्योगिक ग्लूकोज के निर्माण के लिए बड़े व्यावसायिक पैमाने पर कौन सी भौतिक कच्ची सामग्रियां संघनित की जाती हैं?
o: Pure crystalline fructose blocks using volatile petroleum ethers
Starch boiled with dilute sulfuric acid under elevated pressure (डाइल्यूट एसिड के साथ स्टार्च का जलअपघटन)
Animal protein residues mixed with concentrated sodium hydroxide
Teflon sheets subjected to free-radical peroxide streams
e: Explanation: Commercially, glucose is manufactured on a large scale via the acid-catalyzed hydrolysis of starch (isolated from corn or potatoes) by boiling it with dilute $H_2SO_4$ under pressure at 393 K.

qe: What molecular information was discovered about the arrangement of carbon atoms in glucose when it was subjected to prolonged heating with hydrogen iodide ($HI$)?
qh: ग्लूकोज को हाइड्रोजन आयोडाइड ($HI$) के साथ लंबे समय तक गर्म करने पर उसके कार्बन परमाणुओं की व्यवस्था के बारे में क्या आणविक जानकारी प्राप्त हुई थी?
o: It proved that the carbons form a tightly bound cyclic sulfimide ring structure
It confirmed that all six carbon atoms are linked together in a continuous straight chain (छह कार्बन परमाणु सीधी श्रृंखला में हैं)
It revealed that the backbone is highly branched with two quaternary carbons
It indicated that the skeleton contains alternating ester and amide linkages
e: Explanation: Heating D-glucose with $HI$ reduces the carbohydrate completely to n-hexane ($CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3$). The formation of this unbranched alkane proves that all six carbon atoms in glucose are arranged in a continuous, straight chain.

qe: The formation of an oxime when glucose reacts with hydroxylamine ($NH_2OH$) confirms the presence of which functional grouping inside the sugar?
qh: जब ग्लूकोज हाइड्रोक्साइलामाइन ($NH_2OH$) के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करके एक ऑक्सीम (oxime) बनाता है, तो यह चीनी के भीतर किस कार्यात्मक समूह की उपस्थिति की पुष्टि करता है?
o: A primary aliphatic alcohol pool
A carbonyl group ($C=O$ समूह की उपस्थिति)
A cross-linked phenolic bridge network
A terminal trichloro ester linkage
e: Explanation: Hydroylamine reacts specifically with carbonyl centers ($C=O$) via nucleophilic addition-elimination to yield an oxime, confirming that glucose contains a carbonyl group (an aldehyde or ketone).

qe: Which organic product is generated when mild oxidation of glucose is carried out using bromine water ($Br_2/H_2O$)?
qh: जब ब्रोमीन जल ($Br_2/H_2O$) का उपयोग करके ग्लूकोज का हल्का ऑक्सीकरण (mild oxidation) किया जाता है, तो कौन सा कार्बनिक उत्पाद उत्पन्न होता है?
o: Saccharic acid containing two terminal carboxyls
Gluconic acid (ग्लूकोनिक अम्ल)
n-Hexane unbranched alkane chain
Acetylated penta-acetate crystals
e: Explanation: Bromine water is a mild oxidizing agent that selectively converts the terminal aldehyde group (C1) of glucose into a carboxylic acid without altering the hydroxyl groups, yielding gluconic acid.

qe: What structural information is proven about glucose when its reaction with acetic anhydride yields glucose pentaacetate?
qh: ग्लूकोज के बारे में क्या संरचनात्मक जानकारी प्रमाणित होती है जब एसिटिक एनहाइड्राइड के साथ उसकी प्रतिक्रिया से ग्लूकोज पेंटाएसीटेट प्राप्त होता है?
o: It establishes that the carbon skeleton is highly branched and volatile
It confirms the presence of exactly five hydroxyl groups across the molecule (पाँच -OH समूहों की उपस्थिति)
It proves that the sugar contains a secondary cyclic sulfimide ring system
It indicates that the primary functional group is an amide linkage
e: Explanation: Acetylating glucose with acetic anhydride converts free hydroxyl groups into acetate groups. Producing a stable pentaacetate derivative demonstrates the presence of five hydroxyl groups attached to different carbon atoms.

qe: Oxidation of both glucose and gluconic acid with a strong oxidizing agent like nitric acid ($HNO_3$) produces which specific dicarboxylic acid?
qh: नाइट्रिक एसिड ($HNO_3$) जैसे मजबूत ऑक्सीकरण एजेंट के साथ ग्लूकोज और ग्लूकोनिक एसिड दोनों का ऑक्सीकरण करने पर कौन सा विशिष्ट डाइकारबॉक्सिलिक एसिड बनता है?
o: Adipic acid fiber building blocks
Saccharic acid (सैकैरिक अम्ल)
Aminocaproic acid segment
Propionic acid mold inhibitor
e: Explanation: Nitric acid ($HNO_3$) is a powerful oxidizing agent that oxidizes both the terminal aldehyde (or monocarboxylic acid group of gluconic acid) and the terminal primary alcohol group (C6) of glucose into carboxylic acid groups, producing saccharic acid.

qe: What does the lowercase letter 'd' or a plus sign ($+$) signify when positioned before the chemical name of a sugar like D-($+$)-glucose?
qh: D-($+$)-ग्लूकोज जैसी शर्करा के रासायनिक नाम से पहले रखे जाने पर लोअरकेस अक्षर 'd' या प्लस चिह्न ($+$) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The architectural branching density along the polyolefin tail
The dextrorotatory optical activity of the compound, meaning it rotates plane-polarized light to the right (दक्षिणध्रुवण घूर्णक प्रकृति)
The total presence of chlorinated sucrose derivative segments
The step-growth condensation rate profile of the material
e: Explanation: In carbohydrate nomenclature, a plus sign ($+$) or lowercase 'd' indicates that the compound is dextrorotatory, meaning it physically rotates plane-polarized light in a clockwise (rightward) direction.

qe: What structural configuration does the uppercase letter 'D' represent when defining the stereochemistry of a sugar relative to glyceraldehyde?
qh: ग्लिसराल्डिहाइड के सापेक्ष शर्करा के स्टीरियोकेमिस्ट्री को परिभाषित करते समय अपरकेस अक्षर 'D' किस संरचनात्मक विन्यास का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: The compound has a high overall density relative to standard water indices
The hydroxyl group attached to the lowest asymmetric (second-last) carbon atom points to the right side in the Fischer projection (सबसे नीचे वाले असममित कार्बन पर -OH दाईं ओर होना)
The molecule is entirely synthetic and undergoes ring-opening cleavage
The framework contains an alternating array of amide links
e: Explanation: The uppercase letter 'D' indicates spatial configuration, specifying that the hydroxyl group attached to the highest-numbered chiral center (the lowest asymmetric carbon, C5 in glucose) points to the right side in a Fischer projection, matching D-(+)-glyceraldehyde.

qe: Despite having a free aldehyde group in its open-chain structure, glucose fails to form a crystalline addition product with which classic reagent?
qh: अपनी खुली श्रृंखला संरचना में एक मुक्त एल्डिहाइड समूह होने के बावजूद, ग्लूकोज किस क्लासिक अभिकर्मक के साथ एक क्रिस्टलीय अतिरिक्त उत्पाद (crystalline addition product) बनाने में विफल रहता है?
o: Hydroxylamine ($NH_2OH$)
Sodium hydrogen sulfite ($NaHSO_3$ - सोडियम हाइड्रोजन सल्फाइट)
Acetic anhydride solution
Hydrogen iodide liquid streams
e: Explanation: Although open-chain aldehydes readily react with sodium hydrogen sulfite ($NaHSO_3$) to form crystalline addition compounds, glucose fails to undergo this reaction, indicating that its aldehyde group is involved in an equilibrium lock, typical of a cyclic structure.

qe: Why does the structural pentaacetate derivative of D-glucose fail to react with hydroxylamine ($NH_2OH$) to yield an oxime target?
qh: D-ग्लूकोज का संरचनात्मक पेंटाएसीटेट व्युत्पन्न (pentaacetate derivative) एक ऑक्सीम प्राप्त करने के लिए हाइड्रोक्साइलामाइन ($NH_2OH$) के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करने में क्यों विफल रहता है?
o: The compound turns completely insoluble in all organic solvents
The acetylation locks the sugar into a stable cyclic hemiacetal form, leaving no free carbonyl group available to open and react (मुक्त -CHO समूह की अनुपस्थिति)
The reaction requires the addition of high concentrations of sulfur builders
The treatment converts the acetate groups into narrow-spectrum antibiotics
e: Explanation: Glucose pentaacetate does not form an oxime with $NH_2OH$ because acetylating the hydroxyl groups stabilizes the cyclic hemiacetal structure. This prevents the ring from opening to regenerate the free reactive aldehyde group ($-CHO$) required for oxime formation.

qe: What physical parameter confirms that D-glucose naturally crystallizes into two distinct structural forms known as alpha and beta?
qh: कौन सा भौतिक पैरामीटर इस बात की पुष्टि करता है कि D-ग्लूकोज स्वाभाविक रूप से दो अलग-अलग संरचनात्मक रूपों में क्रिस्टलीकृत होता है जिन्हें अल्फा और बीटा के रूप में जाना जाता है?
o: They exhibit completely different chemical percentages of nitrogen atoms
They display different physical melting points and undergo mutarotation profiles upon dissolution (अलग-अलग गलनांक का होना)
One form turns entirely volatile at room temperature boundaries
They react differently with non-ionic laundry detergent builders
e: Explanation: D-glucose exists in two crystalline structures: $\alpha$-D-glucose (melting point 419 K, isolated at 303 K) and $\beta$-D-glucose (melting point 423 K, isolated at 371 K from a hot solution). These distinct melting points demonstrate its two distinct cyclic architectures.

qe: The cyclic intramolecular hemiacetal ring of glucose is closed by an oxygen bridge established between which two specific carbon centers?
qh: ग्लूकोज का चक्रीय इंट्राआणविक हेमीएसिटेल रिंग (intramolecular hemiacetal ring) किन दो विशिष्ट कार्बन केंद्रों के बीच स्थापित ऑक्सीजन पुल द्वारा बंद होता है?
o: Carbon-1 and Carbon-4
Carbon-1 and Carbon-5 (C1 एवं C5 कार्बन परमाणु)
Carbon-2 and Carbon-6
Carbon-3 and Carbon-5
e: Explanation: The cyclic structure of glucose forms when the hydroxyl group at the C5 position adds nucleophilically into the C1 aldehyde center, creating a stable six-membered intramolecular hemiacetal ring configuration.

qe: What formal chemical designation is given to the two cyclic structures of glucose (alpha and beta) that differ in configuration exclusively at the C1 position?
qh: ग्लूकोज की दो चक्रीय संरचनाओं (अल्फा और बीटा) को क्या औपचारिक रासायनिक नाम दिया गया है जो विशेष रूप से C1 स्थिति पर विन्यास (configuration) में भिन्न हैं?
o: Enantiomeric isomers
Anomers (ऐनोमर)
Thermosetting dynamic resins
Linear tactical oligomers
e: Explanation: Cyclic hemiacetals that differ in spatial configuration exclusively at the new asymmetric chiral center (C1 in aldoses, known as the anomeric carbon) are termed anomers.

qe: What specific six-membered heterocyclic oxygen-containing ring serves as the architectural blueprint for drawing Haworth structures of glucose?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट छह-सदस्यीय हेटरोसाइक्लिक ऑक्सीजन-युक्त रिंग ग्लूकोज की हावर्थ संरचनाओं (Haworth structures) को बनाने के लिए संरचनात्मक खाका के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Furan ring system
Pyran ring system (पायरन वलय)
Disulfide bridge layout
Methylene amide coordinate zone
e: Explanation: Haworth projections of cyclic glucose are called pyranose structures because they resemble pyran, a stable six-membered heterocyclic ring containing five carbon atoms and one oxygen atom.

qe: What chemical classification and operational structural name are assigned to the natural monosaccharide known as D-(-)-fructose?
qh: D-(-)-फ्रुक्टोज के रूप में जाने जाने वाले प्राकृतिक मोनोसेकेराइड को कौन सा रासायनिक वर्गीकरण और परिचालन संरचनात्मक नाम दिया गया है?
o: Aldohexose polymer; Orlon substitute
Ketohexose (कीटोहेक्सोज)
Linear dicarboxylic acid; Saccharic resin
Cationic quaternary nitrogen matrix
e: Explanation: D-fructose contains six carbon atoms and a ketone functional group at the C2 position, classifying it as a ketohexose sugar molecule.

qe: What does the minus sign ($-$) in the nomenclature of D-(-)-fructose structurally signify about its physical behavior in solution?
qh: D-(-)-फ्रुक्टोज के नामकरण में माइनस चिह्न ($-$) समाधान में इसके भौतिक व्यवहार के बारे में संरचनात्मक रूप से क्या दर्शाता है?
o: It represents a net negative electrical charge across the polyolefin tail
It indicates that the compound is levorotatory, meaning it rotates plane-polarized light to the left (वामध्रुवण घूर्णक प्रकृति)
It signifies that the molecule undergoes rapid thermal decomposition
It marks the complete exclusion of asymmetric carbon centers
e: Explanation: A minus sign ($-$) in carbohydrate chemistry indicates that the molecule is levorotatory, meaning it rotates the polarization vector of plane-polarized light in a counter-clockwise (leftward) direction.

qe: The cyclic intramolecular ring closure of D-fructose yields a five-membered ring structure modeled after which heterocyclic organic blueprint?
qh: D-फ्रुक्टोज का चक्रीय इंट्राआणविक रिंग बंद होना किस हेटरोसाइक्लिक कार्बनिक खाका के आधार पर पांच-सदस्यीय रिंग संरचना प्रदान करता है?
o: Pyran heterocyclic layout
Furan ring system (फ्यूरान संरचना)
Methylene cross-link frame
Linear tactoid network
e: Explanation: Fructose closes into a five-membered ring via a hemiketal link between the C5 hydroxyl and C2 ketone centers. Because this five-membered configuration contains four carbons and one oxygen atom, it is called a furanose structure, modeled after furan.

qe: What formal name defines the covalent ether-like oxygen linkage that joins two monosaccharide subunits together to construct a disaccharide or polysaccharide?
qh: कौन सा औपचारिक नाम उस सहसंयोजक ईथर-जैसी ऑक्सीजन लिंकेज को परिभाषित करता है जो एक डिसेकेराइड या पॉलीसेकेराइड का निर्माण करने के लिए दो मोनोसेकेराइड उपइकाइयों को एक साथ जोड़ती है?
o: Peptide bond linkage
Glycosidic linkage (ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridge
Sulfur disulfide cross-link
e: Explanation: Monosaccharides link together via a condensation reaction that expels a water molecule. The resulting carbon-oxygen-carbon ($C-O-C$) covalent bridge holding the units together is termed a glycosidic linkage.

qe: Why is table sugar (sucrose) explicitly classified as a non-reducing sugar, unlike maltose and lactose?
qh: माल्टोज़ और लैक्टोज़ के विपरीत, टेबल शुगर (सुक्रोज) को अनअपचायी शर्करा (non-reducing sugar) के रूप में क्यों वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Because it breaks down entirely into volatile open-chain mineral gases
Because the reducing carbonyl groups of both glucose (C1) and fructose (C2) are locked together in the glycosidic bond, leaving no free reducing center (अपचायी समूह बंधित होते हैं)
To maximize its solubility profile across non-polar aromatic fluids
Because it consists entirely of a linear unbranched synthetic polyamide lattice
e: Explanation: In sucrose, the glycosidic bond links the C1 anomeric carbon of $\alpha$-D-glucose directly to the C2 anomeric carbon of $\beta$-D-fructose. Because both reducing carbonyl centers are locked in this bond, the sugar cannot open into a free aldehyde or ketone form, making it non-reducing.

qe: Why does a solution of sucrose exhibit the unique optical physical phenomenon known as 'inversion of sugar' upon undergoing chemical hydrolysis?
qh: रासायनिक जलअपघटन से गुजरने पर सुक्रोज का समाधान 'शर्करा का अपवर्तन' (inversion of sugar) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले अनूठे ऑप्टिकल भौतिक घटना को क्यों प्रदर्शित करता है?
o: Because the solution completely solidifies into an amorphous non-crystalline mass
Because the net optical rotation shifts from dextrorotatory ($+$) to levorotatory ($-$) due to the strong levorotatory property of the released fructose (घूर्णन का चिह्न बदल जाना)
Because it causes the immediate destruction of all chiral asymmetric centers
Because it releases fuming nitric acid vapors that bleach light signals
e: Explanation: Sucrose is dextrorotatory ($+66.5^\circ$). Hydrolysis yields an equimolar mixture of D-(+)-glucose ($+52.5^\circ$) and D-(-)-fructose ($-92.4^\circ$). Because the negative rotation of fructose is larger than the positive rotation of glucose, the overall mixture is levorotatory ($-$), inverting the optical sign.

qe: Which specific monomer configuration and linkage structure constitute the molecular network of the disaccharide maltose?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट मोनोमर विन्यास और लिंकेज संरचना डिसेकेराइड माल्टोज़ के आणविक नेटवर्क का निर्माण करती है?
o: Two $\beta$-D-galactose units linked via an alternating C1-C6 bridge
Two $\alpha$-D-glucose units joined by a C1-C4 glycosidic linkage (दो $\alpha$-D-ग्लूकोज इकाइयाँ C1-C4 बंध द्वारा)
One linear Novolac strand cross-linked with formaldehyde segments
One molecule of fructose linked to a chlorinated sucrose ring skeleton
e: Explanation: Maltose is a disaccharide composed of two $\alpha$-D-glucose units. The glycosidic bond connects the C1 carbon of one glucose unit to the C4 carbon of the adjacent glucose unit, leaving the other C1 center free to act as a reducing sugar.

qe: What specific structural arrangement defines the carbohydrate architecture of lactose (milk sugar)?
qh: कौन सी विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक व्यवस्था लैक्टोज (दूध शर्करा) की कार्बोहाइड्रेट वास्तुकला को परिभाषित करती है?
o: A linear homopolymer of highly branched alpha glucose units linked via c1-c6 chains
A disaccharide composed of $\beta$-D-galactose and $\beta$-D-glucose units joined via a C1-C4 glycosidic bond ($\beta$-D-गैलेक्टोज एवं $\beta$-D-ग्लूकोज C1-C4 बंध द्वारा)
A cross-linked dynamic network of melamine and formaldehyde strands
An open-chain carbohydrate mesh held together by weak disulfide links
e: Explanation: Lactose is a disaccharide composed of $\beta$-D-galactose and $\beta$-D-glucose. The glycosidic linkage forms via a condensation step linking the C1 position of galactose to the C4 position of glucose.

qe: What are the two primary structural fractions that make up the multi-component plant polysaccharide known as starch?
qh: मल्टी-घटक संयंत्र पॉलीसेकेराइड जिसे स्टार्च के रूप में जाना जाता है, बनाने वाले दो प्राथमिक संरचनात्मक अंश (structural fractions) क्या हैं?
o: Cellulose and pristine natural latex fluid sections
Amylose and Amylopectin (एमाइलोज एवं एमाइलोपेक्टिन)
Glycogen and animal-based structural keratin sheets
Linear Novolac bands and cross-linked Bakelite steps
e: Explanation: Starch is a natural plant polymer consisting of two structurally distinct polysaccharide fractions: amylose (a water-soluble linear polymer) and amylopectin (a water-insoluble branched polymer).

qe: What physical parameter and structural layout distinguish the amylose fraction of starch from its counterpart amylopectin?
qh: कौन सा भौतिक पैरामीटर और संरचनात्मक लेआउट स्टार्च के एमाइलोज अंश को उसके प्रतिरूप एमाइलोपेक्टिन से अलग करता है?
o: Amylose is highly branched and completely toxic to mammalian cells
Amylose is a water-soluble, unbranched straight chain of $\alpha$-D-glucose units linked via C1-C4 bonds (एमाइलोज जल में घुलनशील तथा अशाखित श्रृंखला है)
Amylose forms a three-dimensional cross-linked framework containing sulfur links
Amylose is derived exclusively from the oxidation of cellulose acetate sheets
e: Explanation: Amylose constitutes about $15-20\%$ of starch and is water-soluble. Structurally, it is an unbranched, straight chain composed of $200-1000$ $\alpha$-D-glucose units held together by C1-C4 glycosidic bonds.

qe: Which specific architectural branching combination characterizes the structural arrangement of the amylopectin fraction of starch?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक शाखाकरण संयोजन (architectural branching combination) स्टार्च के एमाइलोपेक्टिन अंश की संरचनात्मक व्यवस्था की विशेषता है?
o: A linear array of beta sugar segments lacking branching links completely
A branched chain network where the main chain features C1-C4 links, and branching occurs via C1-C6 glycosidic bonds (मुख्य श्रृंखला में C1-C4 तथा शाखाओं में C1-C6 बंध)
An open-ring cyclic cluster stabilized by weak van der Waals fields
A quaternary nitrogen halide structure balanced by tracking sodium cations
e: Explanation: Amylopectin constitutes $80-85\%$ of starch and is water-insoluble. It is a highly branched polymer where linear glucose strands are formed by C1-C4 glycosidic links, and branching points emerge via C1-C6 glycosidic links.

qe: What structural feature characterizes the molecular composition of cellulose, which serves as the primary structural component of plant cell walls?
qh: पौधों की कोशिका भित्ति के प्राथमिक संरचनात्मक घटक के रूप में कार्य करने वाले सेलुलोज की आणविक संरचना की क्या विशेषता है?
o: A highly branched polymer composed of alpha glucose units with sulfur links
A straight-chain linear polysaccharide composed entirely of $\beta$-D-glucose units joined by C1-C4 glycosidic links ($\beta$-D-ग्लूकोज इकाइयों की सीधी श्रृंखला)
A cyclic grid of chlorinated sucrose molecules that resist structural cleavage
A cross-linked network of synthetic polyamides containing peptide segments
e: Explanation: Cellulose is an unbranched, straight-chain natural polysaccharide. It consists of repeating $\beta$-D-glucose units linked linearly via C1-C4 glycosidic bonds, enabling the strands to align into rigid structural fibers.

qe: Which native polysaccharide functions as the primary metabolic energy reserve macromolecule stored within animal bodies, leading to its name 'animal starch'?
qh: कौन सा प्राकृतिक पॉलीसेकेराइड जानवरों के शरीर के भीतर संग्रहीत प्राथमिक चयापचय ऊर्जा आरक्षित मैक्रोमोलेक्यूल के रूप में कार्य करता है, जिससे इसका नाम 'एनिमल स्टार्च' पड़ा?
o: Cellulose structural mesh
Glycogen (ग्लाइकोजन)
Orlon fiber matrix
Dacron resin coating
e: Explanation: Carbohydrates are stored in the animal body (primarily in the liver, muscles, and brain) as glycogen. Because its highly branched structure resembles amylopectin, it is commonly called 'animal starch'.

qe: What structural transformation occurs in the human body when blood glucose levels drop, and metabolic energy must be rapidly mobilized from glycogen reserves?
qh: जब रक्त शर्करा का स्तर गिरता है तो मानव शरीर में क्या संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन होता है, और ग्लाइकोजन भंडार से चयापचय ऊर्जा को तेजी से जुटाया जाना चाहिए?
o: The glycogen matrix completely solidifies into rigid structural bones
Specific enzymes break down the glycogen polymer directly into glucose units (एंजाइम ग्लाइकोजन को ग्लूकोज में तोड़ते हैं)
The carbohydrate chains undergo spontaneous conversion into volatile ethanol
The framework dissolves into open-chain saccharic acid variants
e: Explanation: When the body requires glucose, specific metabolic enzymes break down the highly branched glycogen polymer, releasing single glucose units into the bloodstream to maintain homeostatic energy levels.

qe: Which chemical component forms the fundamental monomer unit required to construct structural protein macromolecules?
qh: कौन सा रासायनिक घटक संरचनात्मक प्रोटीन मैक्रोमोलेक्यूल्स के निर्माण के लिए आवश्यक मूलभूत मोनोमर इकाई बनाता है?
o: Chloroprene alkene compounds
Alpha-amino acids ($\alpha$-अमीनो अम्ल)
Acrylonitrile fragments
Pyranose sugar units
e: Explanation: Proteins are biological heteropolymers composed of long chains of amino acids linked together. Specifically, only $\alpha$-amino acids serve as the building blocks for protein synthesis.

qe: What specific spatial layout defines an amino acid as an 'alpha-amino acid' inside structural biochemistry?
qh: संरचनात्मक जैव रसायन के भीतर कौन सा विशिष्ट स्थानिक लेआउट एक अमीनो एसिड को 'अल्फा-अमीनो एसिड' के रूप में परिभाषित करता है?
o: The amino group is separated from the carboxyl group by five carbon blocks
The amino group ($-NH_2$) is directly attached to the alpha-carbon atom positioned adjacent to the carboxyl group ($-COOH$) (अमीनो समूह का $\alpha$-कार्बन पर होना)
The structure contains an alternating array of chlorinated aromatic groups
The functional centers are locked in a cyclic seven-membered ring matrix
e: Explanation: In $\alpha$-amino acids, the amino group ($-NH_2$) is bonded directly to the $\alpha$-carbon, which is the carbon atom positioned adjacent to the carboxylic acid functional group ($-COOH$).

qe: Which structural feature characterises the simple amino acid known as glycine, making it unique among the twenty standard proteinogenic amino acids?
qh: सरल अमीनो एसिड जिसे ग्लाइसीन के रूप में जाना जाता है, की कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता उसे बीस मानक प्रोटीनजन्य (proteinogenic) अमीनो एसिड के बीच अद्वितीय बनाती है?
o: It contains a high concentration of sulfur cross-link arrays
Its side chain (R-group) is a single hydrogen atom, making it the only optically inactive amino acid (यह प्रकाशिक अक्रिय होता है)
It displays a rigid cyclic configuration identical to Novolac chains
It lacks a carboxylic acid functional group within its framework
e: Explanation: In glycine, the side chain 'R' is a simple hydrogen atom ($H$). Because the $\alpha$-carbon is bonded to two identical hydrogen atoms, it lacks a chiral center, making glycine the only optically inactive standard amino acid.

qe: What terminology defines the dual-charged, dipolar ion structure generated when the carboxylic group of an amino acid transfers its proton to its internal amino center?
qh: एमिनो एसिड का कार्बोक्सिलिक समूह जब अपने प्रोटॉन को आंतरिक अमीनो केंद्र में स्थानांतरित करता है तो उत्पन्न दोहरे चार्ज (dual-charged), द्विध्रुवीय आयन संरचना को क्या शब्दावली परिभाषित करती है?
o: Anomeric intermediate ion
Zwitterion (ज्विटर आयन)
Cationic surfactant lattice
Non-ionic dynamic ester ion
e: Explanation: In aqueous solution, the acidic carboxyl group ($-COOH$) of an amino acid can transfer a proton to the basic amino group ($-NH_2$). This internal acid-base reaction generates a dipolar ion containing both a negative and a positive charge, known as a zwitterion.

qe: Why do standard amino acids display high physical melting points and solid salt-like characteristics, unlike simple amines or organic carboxylic acids?
qh: मानक अमीनो एसिड सरल एमाइन या कार्बनिक कार्बोक्सिलिक एसिड के विपरीत उच्च भौतिक गलनांक और ठोस नमक-जैसे लक्षण क्यों प्रदर्शित करते हैं?
o: Because they evaporate completely into non-polar gases at room boundaries
Because they exist as dipolar zwitterions stabilized by strong electrostatic forces of attraction (ज्विटर आयन रूप में एजिस्ट करना)
Because they contain permanent disulfide bridges across their structural zones
Because they lack ionizable functional groups entirely across their backbones
e: Explanation: Amino acids exist primarily as dipolar zwitterions. This ionic configuration creates strong electrostatic forces of attraction between adjacent units, resulting in high melting points, crystalline solid forms, and high water solubility, behaving like inorganic salts.

qe: Which stereochemical configuration characterizes almost all naturally occurring chiral alpha-amino acids isolated from biological protein systems?
qh: जैविक प्रोटीन प्रणालियों से पृथक लगभग सभी प्राकृतिक रूप से पाए जाने वाले कायरल अल्फा-अमीनो एसिड की क्या स्टीरियोकेमिकल विशेषता (stereochemical configuration) है?
o: D-configuration layout across all chiral positions
L-configuration layout (L-विन्यास रूप)
Alternating racemic array containing zero active centers
Highly cross-linked three-dimensional network geometry
e: Explanation: Unlike sugars, which predominantly exhibit the D-configuration, almost all naturally occurring chiral $\alpha$-amino acids isolated from proteins belong to the L-configuration series, with the amino group on the left side in Fischer projections.

qe: What specific biochemical amide linkage forms when the carboxyl group of one amino acid condenses with the amino group of an adjacent unit?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट जैव रासायनिक एमाइड लिंकेज तब बनता है जब एक अमीनो एसिड का कार्बोक्सिल समूह दूसरे आसन्न इकाई के अमीनो समूह के साथ संघनित होता है?
o: Glycosidic linkage
Peptide linkage / Peptide bond (पेप्टाइड बंध / लिंकेज)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridge
Sulfur disulfide cross-link
e: Explanation: Condensing the $-COOH$ group of one amino acid with the $-NH_2$ group of another eliminates a water molecule, establishing a covalent amide linkage ($-CONH-$) termed a peptide bond or peptide linkage.

qe: What structural rule dictates the functional designation and number of peptide bonds present within a peptide chain classified as a tripeptide?
qh: त्रिपिटाइड (tripeptide) के रूप में वर्गीकृत पेप्टाइड श्रृंखला के भीतर मौजूद कार्यात्मक पदनाम और पेप्टाइड बांडों की संख्या को कौन सा संरचनात्मक नियम निर्धारित करता है?
o: It contains three peptide bonds linking two amino acid blocks together
It is composed of exactly three amino acid residues held together by two peptide bonds (तीन अमीनो अम्ल दो पेप्टाइड बंधों द्वारा)
It contains a cross-linked matrix of three independent sulfur bridges
It forms a volatile open chain containing three uncharged ether links
e: Explanation: A tripeptide is named for the number of amino acid components it contains, not the number of bonds. It is composed of three amino acid residues linked sequentially by two peptide bonds.

qe: What structural term defines the specific linear sequence in which amino acids are covalently bound together to form a polypeptide chain?
qh: कौन सा संरचनात्मक शब्द उस विशिष्ट रैखिक अनुक्रम (linear sequence) को परिभाषित करता है जिसमें अमीनो एसिड एक पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला बनाने के लिए सहसंयोजक रूप से एक साथ बंधे होते हैं?
o: Primary structure of protein (प्रोटीन की प्राथमिक संरचना)
Secondary alpha-helix layout
Tertiary global folding matrix
Quaternary multi-subunit grid
e: Explanation: The primary structure of a protein refers to the exact linear sequence of amino acid residues along its polypeptide chain. Any mutation or change in this sequence alters the protein's overall identity and function.
